name: Server Request Waterfall
Action: Sequential awaits inside a Server Component hierarchy where independent network queries wait for earlier queries to finish before starting.
reason: Multiplies tail latencies and inflates Time to First Byte (TTFB) unnecessarily.

name: Parallel Promise Initiation
Action: Starting independent async calls concurrently and awaiting them with Promise.all or passing unawaited promises to child components.
reason: Collapses total wait time from the sum of latencies to the maximum single latency.

name: Granular <Suspense> Boundary
Action: Wrapping slow non-critical subtrees in <Suspense fallback={...}> while rendering critical above-the-fold content immediately.
reason: Flushes the primary page shell over HTTP right away and streams secondary chunks as they resolve.

name: Streaming with React.use()
Action: Creating a promise in a Server Component and passing it as a prop to a Client Component that unwraps it with use(promise) inside Suspense.
reason: Starts data fetching on the server immediately without blocking the Server Component render pass.
